card.name: Inside brand names and acronyms
card.fires_on: Middle pieces of capitalized brand names or disease acronyms that are split into parts, such as EM-TR-IVA, CD-AD, ENTY-VIO or CABT-RE-O. It fires on a repeat mention after the name has already appeared.

modes.label: Brand name pieces
modes.description: A middle piece of an all-caps drug brand name, mentioned again in the text.

modes.label: Disease acronym pieces
modes.description: The second or later piece of a disease acronym such as CDAD or RPLS.
